readingText.content:
July 1st

Today was my first day at the amusement park! I was really excited to start. I met a lot of new people. They were very friendly. Today, I’m working at the food stall. The rides look amazing, but I can’t go on them while I’m working. The bad thing is my uniform. I have to wear a really ugly yellow and green T-shirt. It’s not very comfortable.

July 2nd

I’m very tired. I was on my feet for seven hours. I think I served more than 500 drinks and 250 hotdogs. How do people eat all the time? A man ordered four burgers at 10 o’clock this morning.

July 3rd

Wow. Today was very different. I worked at the roller coaster. It’s big. Very big. Huge! I have to give very clear security instructions: You mustn’t take selfies on the roller coaster.

You have to sit down. You mustn’t get on here with your dog. Everybody is screaming all the time, it’s so loud!

July 4th

I’m really tired. I can’t write today.

July 5th

Today, I found six mobile phones in the park. People lose them all the time here! I tried to find the owners, but my manager said, ‘It’s OK, you don’t have to do that. Just give them to me.’

I never saw the phones again. Maybe he has them in his office?
